title: Aliyetajwa Katika Nyumba ya Mtume
intro: Katika nyumba ya mjumbe wa mwisho, kuliishi nafsi ambayo hadithi yake binafsi ikawa somo takatifu kwa waumini wote. Maisha ya mtu huyu yaliunganishwa kwa karibu na amri ya mabadiliko ambayo ilibadilisha mila za kijamii milele, ikiashiria mabadiliko makubwa katika jinsi imani ingefafanua familia na kumilikiwa.
clues: Jina langu hapo awali lilihusishwa na ukoo mtukufu, lakini ukweli wa juu zaidi baadaye ungefafanua vifungo vya kweli vya imani.
Nilikuwa mpokeaji wa neema kubwa kutoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume wake, neema ambayo ilitangazwa hadharani katika Kitabu.
Maisha yangu ya ndoa yakawa mtihani muhimu ambao ungebadilisha milele mtazamo wa mahusiano ya kuasili.
Mimi ndiye niliyekuwa mtu ambaye kesi yangu binafsi ilisababisha amri ya Mungu iliyomruhusu Mtume kuoa mwanamke baada ya mimi kuondoka.
Kupitia hadithi yangu, tofauti kati ya familia ya kibaolojia na familia teule iliwekwa wazi kwa vizazi vyote.
Mimi ndiye pekee miongoni mwa wenzangu ambaye jina lake linaonekana waziwazi katika ufunuo wa mwisho, si kama nabii, bali kama mtumishi aliyejaribiwa na kuheshimiwa.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
